title: Canonical public repository metadata and discoverability
objective: Make the canonical GitHub repository itself a coherent Deskal launch entrypoint by pinning and applying evidence-bounded public repository metadata that points to the live Deskal Pages site, without changing releases, installers, runtime authority, merge policy, Pages hosting mode, or any secret-bearing infrastructure.

desired_metadata.description: Local-first MCP authority layer for safe, bounded computer use and developer workflows.

include: a machine-readable canonical repository-metadata record committed to the repository
GitHub repository description set exactly to the approved evidence-bounded Deskal description
GitHub repository homepage set exactly to the canonical HTTPS Pages URL
GitHub repository topics set to the approved bounded discoverability allowlist
regression checks that keep the canonical metadata record aligned with the Deskal website and README public entrypoints
post-application GitHub API verification that the public metadata matches the canonical record
exclude: creating, editing, publishing, deleting, or retagging any GitHub Release
creating, deleting, or moving Git tags
changing custom domain, DNS, Pages build type, Pages source, or Pages HTTPS enforcement
changing repository visibility, default branch, branch protection, merge methods, Actions permissions, secrets, environments, or collaborators
installer changes, package publication, artifact distribution changes, or compatibility identifier migration
changes to Deskal runtime, MCP tools, policy, approvals, trust, leases, providers, browser authority, desktop authority, filesystem authority, network authority, or process authority

authority_delta.filesystem: Repository metadata manifest and regression-test source only; no Deskal runtime filesystem authority change.
authority_delta.network: One bounded GitHub repository-administration metadata update plus read-back verification; no Deskal runtime network authority change.
authority_delta.secrets: No new secret. The existing authorized GitHub connection may perform the metadata mutation.
authority_delta.approval: Repository administration metadata only; no runtime approval change.
authority_delta.privileged: No Deskal privileged-runtime authority. GitHub repository administration is bounded to description, homepage, and topics.

invariants: the metadata record is descriptive only and grants no Deskal authority
homepage remains the canonical HTTPS GitHub Pages URL with no custom domain
topics remain an exact bounded allowlist and do not claim unsupported platforms or capabilities
GitHub Releases and tags remain byte-for-byte and metadata-wise untouched by this grain
repository visibility, default branch, merge settings, branch protection, Actions settings, Pages settings, secrets, environments, and collaborators remain unchanged
all existing Deskal runtime and MCP authority remains unchanged

acceptance.claim: A machine-readable canonical metadata record pins the exact approved description, homepage, and topic allowlist and is regression-tested in CI.
The live GitHub repository description exactly matches the canonical metadata record and remains evidence-bounded.
The live GitHub repository homepage exactly equals https://thehalfmoon.github.io/Deskal/ and that URL returns HTTPS 200.
The live GitHub topic set exactly matches the canonical allowlist: ai-agents, computer-use, desktop-automation, local-first, mcp, mcp-server, windows.
Before-and-after verification proves this grain does not modify GitHub Releases, tags, Pages configuration, repository visibility, default branch, merge methods, or Deskal runtime/MCP source.

Exact-head CI, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, manual review of exclusions, zero unresolved blocking review threads, normal merge, metadata application, API read-back verification, and post-merge CI complete before canonical closeout.

successor_requirements.release_or_tag_change: Any release or tag mutation requires separately authorized successor work.
successor_requirements.custom_domain: Any custom domain or DNS change requires separately authorized successor work.
successor_requirements.repository_policy: Any repository visibility, merge policy, branch protection, Actions, environment, secret, or collaborator change requires separately authorized successor work.

done_when: The canonical metadata record is merged and qualified, the live GitHub description/homepage/topics exactly match it, the Pages homepage is reachable over HTTPS, excluded repository and release settings are proven unchanged, and post-merge CI is green.
